why: Issue #706, found by the visual gate's hit-target sweep (#711) once #690's match-error routing was merged. The rows are re-equalized INSIDE the ResizeObserver callback, as the first version of this module did. Setting the width resizes the observed buttons, the browser reports the undeliverable resize as a window `error` event, and during a match boot routes that to the match-failed overlay, so Pause is never reached. Killed by the case that expects no resize before the frame runs.
killedBy: menu-row-width.ts: one width per Main Menu row (issue #706) resizes nothing inside the observer callback, only on the frame after it
